chapter.heading: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
The LORD
hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

Send thee
help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

Remember all
thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

Grant thee
according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

We will
rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

Now know
I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

Some trust
in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

They are
brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

Save, LORD:
let the king hear us when we call.
